macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. GDP slows to 1.5% in Q2 as imports surge, but consumer spending remains resilient
items.summary: The U.S. economy expanded at a 1.5% annualized pace in the second quarter, down from 2.1% in Q1, as rising imports and softer government spending weighed on growth. The report also showed the Fed’s preferred PCE inflation gauge rose 3.7% year over year in June, while core PCE was up 3.3%.

items.title: Wall Street futures edge higher as oil retreats and investors weigh renewed U.S.-Iran tensions
items.summary: U.S. stock index futures rose modestly as oil prices steadied after fresh U.S. strikes on Iran reignited geopolitical worries. Reuters said investors were balancing the market impact of the conflict against hopes that tensions may not escalate further.

items.title: Oil jumps and Asian stocks face pressure after fresh strikes on Iran
items.summary: Bloomberg reported that oil climbed after renewed U.S. military action in Iran and the revocation of a waiver related to Iranian crude sales, while Asian stocks were poised to weaken again. The move intensified inflation concerns and kept pressure on bonds and rate-sensitive assets.

items.title: IMF cuts 2026 global growth forecast, citing fallout from the Iran war
items.summary: Al Jazeera reported that the IMF lowered its 2026 world growth outlook to 3.0%, saying energy-market disruption from the Iran war is hurting the global economy. The report said stronger AI-related demand is only partly offsetting the shock.

items.title: China producer inflation rises to near four-year high, keeping cost pressures elevated
items.summary: Reuters said China’s producer prices rose for a fourth straight month in June to their highest level since July 2022, while consumer prices also continued to rise. The data point to persistent inflation pressures for manufacturers.

items.title: Japan bond yields hit 30-year high as inflation worries persist
items.summary: Reuters reported that the 10-year Japanese government bond yield reached a 30-year high as higher oil prices renewed inflation concerns. Investors also remained focused on Japan’s fiscal outlook.

items.title: European and Asian equities mixed as investors weigh tech rebound against oil shock
items.summary: Reuters said European shares rose in choppy trade, led by a rebound in technology stocks, while Asian markets gained early but were capped by surging oil prices. Market tone remained cautious as geopolitical risk and inflation fears competed with renewed strength in semiconductors.

items.title: Selected market movers: Samsung surges, broader risk appetite remains uneven
items.summary: MarketScreener’s 24-hour list showed Samsung Electronics up 8.22%, alongside gains in several European financial and industrial names. The same feed showed U.S.-oil dynamics and Fed caution shaping broader market direction.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin trades in a tight range near $63K after Fed and Middle East-driven volatility
items.summary: Bitcoin was mostly flat to slightly lower over the last 24 hours, trading around the low-to-mid $63,000s after volatility tied to the Fed decision and renewed U.S.-Iran tensions. Market coverage also noted roughly $286 million in crypto liquidations during the swings.
items.source: Benzinga / TradingView / Bitcoin News on X

items.title: Ethereum, XRP, Solana and Dogecoin mostly drift as the broader crypto market consolidates
items.summary: Major large-cap tokens were little changed, with Ethereum near $1,900, XRP around $1.07-$1.08, Solana around $73, and Dogecoin near $0.07. The broader crypto market capitalization was reported near $2.18 trillion, down slightly on the day.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs, ETH and SOL products show divergent flow trends
items.summary: Market commentary highlighted a split in exchange-traded product flows, with Ether and Solana products gaining interest while Bitcoin outflows remained substantial. This suggests investors are rotating within crypto exposures rather than exiting the sector entirely.

items.title: TradingView notes Bitcoin touched a new July high above $62K as risk appetite improved
items.summary: One market update said Bitcoin climbed above $63,000 and another said it tapped a new July high above $62,000, helped by softer U.S. inflation expectations and easing oil prices. The reporting indicates sentiment improved even though price action remained range-bound.

items.title: Swedish regulator rejects Goobit AB’s MiCA application
items.summary: Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority rejected Goobit AB’s MiCA application, forcing the company to evaluate its next steps. The decision is notable because it shows how Europe’s crypto licensing regime is already shaping market access.

items.title: Paul Grewal exits Coinbase legal leadership ahead of key CLARITY vote
items.summary: Coinbase’s top legal executive Paul Grewal reportedly stepped down before a crucial CLARITY vote, adding to the policy uncertainty around U.S. crypto legislation. The timing makes the move especially relevant for regulatory watchers.

items.title: Senate debate sharpens over developer protections in broader crypto bill
items.summary: Sen. Wyden urged Senate leaders to preserve contested blockchain developer protections in a larger crypto bill. The issue remains one of the most closely watched regulatory fault lines in U.S. crypto policy.

items.title: Bitdeer unveils $36 million Nevada mining factory
items.summary: Bitdeer announced a new $36 million Nevada factory, signaling continued investment in U.S.-based Bitcoin mining infrastructure. The move adds to a week of project and infrastructure development news in the mining sector.

items.title: Ondo expands tokenized equities with onchain shareholder voting
items.summary: Ondo announced an expansion of tokenized equities that includes onchain shareholder voting. The development underscores ongoing momentum in real-world asset tokenization across crypto markets.

items.title: Robinhood CEO says crypto’s future is in real-world assets, not memecoins
items.summary: Robinhood’s CEO said the next major phase of crypto will center on real-world assets rather than memecoins. The comment aligns with broader industry interest in tokenization and utility-focused blockchain products.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Work for workplace automation
items.summary: OpenAI unveiled ChatGPT Work, an agent inside ChatGPT that can execute tasks across applications and files. The launch intensifies competition in professional AI tools and enterprise automation.

items.title: Meta opens developer access to Muse Spark 1.1
items.summary: Meta released developer access to its Muse Spark AI model and an upgraded version, signaling a push to compete more directly in paid AI model access. The move positions Meta against OpenAI and Anthropic in the enterprise and developer market.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-Live voice models
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-Live, a new family of voice models designed to listen and speak simultaneously in real time. The release adds another multimodal capability to OpenAI's product lineup.

items.title: Anthropic appoints Ben Bernanke to oversight trust
items.summary: Anthropic said it appointed former U.S. Federal Reserve chair Ben Bernanke to its Long-Term Benefit Trust, an oversight body tied to the company's public mission. The appointment highlights governance and safety oversight as a continuing industry focus.

items.title: Italy fines Character.AI owner over data protection breaches
items.summary: Italy's data protection authority fined Character Technologies, the owner of Character.AI, €158,000 for alleged breaches of data protection rules. The case adds to regulatory scrutiny of consumer AI chatbots.

items.title: Reuters reports new AI hardware investment surge from Micron
items.summary: Micron said it plans to invest more than $250 billion in the U.S. through 2035, citing surging memory-chip demand in the AI era. The announcement reflects how AI demand continues to shape semiconductor investment and supply chains.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

tech_news.query: What are the most important technology news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major product launches, company news, and significant tech industry developments. Exclude AI-specific news.

items.title: Swift launches blockchain-based shared ledger with 16 banks
items.summary: Global financial messaging network Swift launched a blockchain-based shared ledger with an initial group of 16 banks, including Citi and HSBC, to support round-the-clock payments and compete with stablecoin-based systems.

items.title: India removes import duty on some electronics and smartphone parts
items.summary: India scrapped import duties on several parts used to make mobile phones and other electronic devices, a move that could lower costs for manufacturers such as Apple and Xiaomi.

items.title: Apple to spend more than $30 billion under Broadcom chip-supply deal
items.summary: Apple said it plans to spend more than $30 billion as part of a chip-supply agreement with Broadcom, which will also expand a factory in Colorado.

items.title: EU backs temporary rules for Big Tech to remove child sexual abuse material
items.summary: EU lawmakers backed a proposal to reinstate interim rules allowing Google, Meta and other platforms to detect and remove online child sexual abuse material while longer-term rules are negotiated.

items.title: Coinbase restores prediction markets trading after technical issue
items.summary: Coinbase said it restored prediction markets trading after resolving a technical issue that had disrupted the service.
